title: 2012 SAGE Hit #70 Cyrus Gray Texas A&M Aggies Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2012 SAGE Hit sports trading card features Cyrus Gray of the Texas A&M Aggies. The card number is 70 and it was manufactured by SAGE. It is a great addition to any football fan's collection and perfect for those who love the NFL. The card is not autographed and is not vintage. It is a single card from the 2012 season and would make a great gift for any sports enthusiast.
